newsitem.title: USA: Thermo unit wins $12 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Thermo unit wins $12 mln contract.

text.p: Thermo TerraTech Inc said on Wednesday that its Lancaster Laboratories subsidiary had been awarded a $12 million contract to perform analytical chemistry services for Mobil Business Resources Corp, a subsidiary of Mobil Corp.
Under the terms of the four-year contract, Lancaster Laboratories will support the Environmental Health and Safety remediation efforts of Mobil's U.S. operations, the company said.
It also said that Mobil would sell certain assets associated with its environmental testing laboratory in Princeton, N.J., to Lancaster Laboratories.
Thermo TerraTech Inc provides environmental services and infrastructure planning, and is a public subsidiary of Thermo Electron Corp.
Lancaster Laboratories, based in Lancaster, Pa., is a commercial testing laboratory providing analytical and consulting services in environmental, food and animal health, and pharmaceutical sciences.
